verdict.rationale: Cal.com ships an official hosted MCP server at mcp.cal.com, plus a local option. Its docs say it lets users manage bookings, event types, schedules and team setup through natural language in any MCP-compatible client, with OAuth onboarding and no API key needed. Natural-language operation still runs through an external AI client rather than a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language command interface, independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works reliably, and documented coverage of which operations are exposed as tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: letting you manage bookings, event types, schedules, and more through natural language in any MCP-compatible client.
